column2: [intro]
I wake up in the morning, a glass of water in hand,
Ideas burst forth, like a marathon grand.
I run all around, with no clear direction,
But in this chaos, I find my connection.
Reflex ideas, oh what a spree,
In my mind, they swirl, they spin, I’m so free,
Reflex ideas, I can't control them all,
But in the chaos, I feel I can stand tall.
At the supermarket, I try to do my shopping,
But my cart turns into a wild, chaotic hopping.
I zigzag through aisles, with no clear intention,
And people stare, not grasping my dimension.
Reflex ideas, oh what a spree,
In my mind, they swirl, they spin, I’m so free,
Reflex ideas, I can't control them all,
But in the chaos, I feel I can stand tall.
